  \ steel. It is 441 mm wide between the ear folds, 44 mm high and 250 mm deep. A detachable cord takes\
  \ IEC C14 input at 15 A. The rear holds eight NEMA 5-15R outlets in one row, each switchable, with a\

  \ holds a power button, a touch strip with an OLED display and a ninth outlet that is not switched.\

  \ V, 12 A input.\n\nDatasheet: Middle Atlantic Premium+ Rack Mount PDU with RackLink A&E specification\
